mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5%, labor market tightness drives wage inflation, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) in periods with UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and rising housing starts (HOUST) signals a broadening economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a single month signals reduced consumer spending power, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) following RSAFS declines > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5%, high borrowing costs reduce economic activity, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) and low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% annually is a persistent driver of positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
